run_cpu_mpstat_hook: run the CpuMpstat hook to collect background CPU utilization data via mpstat during a benchmark job
create_before_job: create a background mpstat process in before_job that writes CPU stats to a metrics file for the job
stop_after_job: stop the background mpstat process in after_job by sending SIGINT then SIGTERM if needed
configure_mpstat_options: configure the CpuMpstat hook with custom mpstat args like utilization flags and poll interval in YAML
review_cpu_mpstat_class: review the CpuMpstat class and its before_job and after_job lifecycle methods for benchmark CPU monitoring
